profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, iOS
profile.summary: A Highly passionate, endlessly curious, and purposely humble Software Engineer with 10+ years in iOS development. I have had the opportunity to work in several different industries getting exposure to and experience with various app architectures and team dynamics. This has allowed me to be flexible in my approach to software while bringing the best of all worlds to the table. I have a track record of strong team leadership, working with my teams to deliver highly valuable features resulting in increased user engagement and more stable codebases.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (iOS)
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: iOS Design · Mobile Application Development · GraphQL · Apollo GraphQL

positions.title: iOS Mobile Developer
positions.description:
• As a part of a large scrum team, I worked alongside a senior engineer to create mobile applications for iPhones, iPads, and desktop applications for macOS. I played a huge part in developing two of the major mobile apps that required the devices to connect to a backend API and allowed of offline usage.
• I created a reusable protocol extension for a TableView class that allowed for quick development and customization of forms across the application. 
• I integrated RxSwift and RxCocoa into the product to help manage sequences of events like API calls and user interactions.
• I was responsible for a product where I created both the backend API service using NodeJS and GraphQL, as well as developing the macOS desktop application to using RealmDB for data persistence. I developed a SQL query builder that allowed users to customize search results in the app.
• The applications were built using Swift, with other technologies such as CoreData, Alamofire, RealmDB, RxSwift, Web Sockets, Promises, Generics, Protocols.
• I also worked with technologies like SQL with web technologies like NodeJS, GraphQL, and ReactJS.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked alongside other developers to create and update our own video games as well as create applications for clients.
• I created an iOS mobile application to act as a companion for a popular video game that had come out that used CoreLocation and GPS to help users track their location and save information regarding that location to a database. I used Alamofire to make network requests and parse the JSON that would be returned.
• I made updates to a web API that we utilized for our video game that stored and retrieved used information and statistics.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
• Worked along side a senior developer to help maintain web applications for various clients. My main responsibilities were to create and maintain websites for clients and address any needs they had.
• I also was responsible for  running code reviews with the senior developer and to test the applications to make sure there weren't any evident bugs before we release the product to development.
• I also began a large refactor on our main CMS web application written in Ruby/Rails to allow for the use of ReactJS on the front end
• The technologies I used were Primarily Ruby on Rails, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL.

projects.title: WorkMode App
projects.description:
WE’RE BUILDING THE NEXT GENERATION, WITH THE NEXT GENERATION.

- Get coached through your workout with your favorite players
- Train with sport and position-specific workouts used by the pros
- Keep your skills sharp year-round and stay ahead of the competition

- Train smarter, not harder — no more wasting precious time searching for workouts with no results

- Join a community of like-minded athletes with big dreams

Unlock your potential with WorkMode — your ultimate companion on the journey to the Big Leagues.

projects.title: Bible Words Master - iOS
projects.description:
Bible Words Master!

This App is the One-Stop-Shop for anyone who desires to learn and master Biblical Greek and Hebrew. Build your vocabulary, practice your parsing forms, read both the Greek and Hebrew Bible, and review various language/grammar concepts. No more hopping between multiple apps to keep up on your language skills. The purpose of Bible Words Master is to give you all the resources you need to succeed in your pursuit of learning the Biblical Languages.
